item.title: Havre Senior Center re-opening next week
item.description: The Hill County Commission announced Friday that the Havre’s North Central Senior Center will be re-opening next week, Feb. 2. The center will be open from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday through Friday for activities only. At the moment, meals will not be served in the center and no pick-up meals will be available.
